addlink_link1: Add a new link of type 1 between two nodes, with its visibility, version, time and data.
addlink_link2: Add a new link of type 2 between two nodes, with its visibility, version, time and data.
addnode: Add a new node with its type, version, time and data.
composed_getnode: Given a node, read the whole record of every node it links to by link type 1.
countlink_link1: Given a node, count its links of link type 1.
countlink_link2: Given a node, count its links of link type 2.
deletelink_link1: Delete a link of type 1 by marking it hidden, leaving the link in place.
deletelink_link2: Delete a link of type 2 by marking it hidden, leaving the link in place.
deletenode: Delete a node's record, leaving its links in place.
getlink_link1: Given a node and a list of target nodes, read the links of type 1 from the node to those targets, with their data.
getlink_link2: Given a node and a list of target nodes, read the links of type 2 from the node to those targets, with their data.
getlinklist_link1: Given a node, list its up to 10,000 newest links of link type 1, with their data.
getlinklist_link2: Given a node, list its up to 10,000 newest links of link type 2, with their data.
getnode: Given a node, read its whole record (type, version, time and data).
updatelink_link1: Rewrite the visibility, version, time and data of an existing link of type 1.
updatelink_link2: Rewrite the visibility, version, time and data of an existing link of type 2.
updatenode: Rewrite the version, time and data of an existing node in one write.
